program_comparison.1_entry: Closed supervised source-entry/clock/jump policies stay frozen; no model or event repair is opened. A full inventory-action value model is a different control question from selecting a new independent entry signal.
program_comparison.2_external: No external economic data; only original native US30M1 and descriptive exact V7 control are used.
program_comparison.3_order_time: No old limit price, market wait, queue or reservation rescue. Ordinary protected market execution and a fixed clock are part of the new complete inventory contract.
program_comparison.4_management: No original position exit or stop overlay. The new book owns its entry, hold/flatten/reverse decisions, immutable initial stop and forced daily completion. Old strategy-specific management is absent only inside the isolated candidate.
program_comparison.5_capital: Select a complete single-book inventory policy, rebuilding all six candidate opportunity laws as one US30 long/flat/short book. Action value depends on current inventory, entry/stop state and transaction cost. Compare frozen and causally updated DoubleDQN from one2024fit. This is not parent pyramiding, daily component weights, a subset, spread book or any retained positive child seed.
program_comparison.7_meta: A zero-position cash reference and complete transition/cost evidence clarify value against inaction. No separate diagnostic/checker or safety stream. The model learns its own state transitions, including stop and switching cost, rather than teacher accepted-trade labels.

coverage_judgment: Recent Program5concentration weighs against another sizing variant. This unit instead removes the original signal population inside a new book and asks whether stateful sequential action learning earns cost-adjusted net value. Its state/label/action law and training data are independent of prior child/gap/spread selections; no positive predecessor outcome is a source/seed.
